lessons.name: end_effector_thermal_drift
lessons.description: End-effector position drift after long runtime (thermal)
lessons.applies_when: After several continuous hours of operation, the arm's end-effector position drifts by a few millimeters relative to its calibrated pose, degrading pick/place accuracy.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when drift correlates with cycle count or payload weight instead of runtime -- that points to mechanical wear or backlash, not thermal.

lessons.name: planner_stall_cluttered_workspace
lessons.description: Motion planner stalls near cluttered workspace boundary
lessons.applies_when: The motion planner reliably finds paths in open space but stalls or times out when the target pose is near the workspace boundary in a densely cluttered scene.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when stalls occur throughout the workspace regardless of boundary proximity -- that's a global density or algorithm-choice issue.

lessons.name: sensor_fusion_jitter_firmware
lessons.description: LiDAR+IMU fusion jitter after a firmware update
lessons.applies_when: After a LiDAR (or IMU) firmware update, the fused pose estimate becomes noticeably jittery even though each sensor looks fine viewed in isolation.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when jitter was present before the firmware update too -- that points to genuine filter tuning or a mechanical vibration source.

lessons.name: battery_early_shutdown
lessons.description: Battery discharge curve triggers early low-power shutdown
lessons.applies_when: The robot shuts down on a low-power protection trip well before its rated runtime or stated remaining charge would predict, especially under heavy motor load.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to a battery genuinely near end-of-life with reduced capacity -- that needs cell replacement, not a cutoff logic change.

lessons.name: gripper_force_overshoot_deformable
lessons.description: Gripper force-control overshoot on deformable objects
lessons.applies_when: A force-controlled gripper occasionally overshoots its target grip force when first contacting a soft/deformable object, briefly exceeding the setpoint enough to deform or damage it.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when overshoot happens on rigid objects too -- that's a general gain-tuning issue, not a compliant-material-specific one.

lessons.name: fleet_charging_deadlock
lessons.description: Fleet coordination deadlock at charging dock
lessons.applies_when: Under high fleet utilization, two or more robots occasionally deadlock near the charging dock, each waiting for a lane or slot the other is occupying, with neither able to proceed or back off.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to deadlocks away from the dock (e.g. in open aisles), which are a general traffic-management issue with a different fix.

queries.query: arm's end-effector position drifts after running for a few hours
pick accuracy degrades over a long shift, positions off by a few millimeters
repeatability gets worse over time, suspect thermal expansion in the joints
path planner times out or stalls when the workspace is near-full of obstacles
arm hesitates or fails to find a path close to the bin edge with many objects
planner works fine in open space but stalls in dense clutter near the boundary
localization jitters after the LiDAR firmware update, IMU fusion looks off
pose estimate noisy since flashing new sensor firmware, timing suspect
sensor fusion output jittery post-update, suspect timestamp misalignment
robot shuts down for low battery well before the rated runtime
low-power cutoff triggers early under heavy motor load
battery reports enough charge remaining but the robot shuts down anyway
gripper crushes or deforms soft objects despite force-control being enabled
force feedback overshoots the setpoint when grasping compliant materials
grip force spikes past target briefly when contacting a soft object
two robots deadlock waiting for the same charging dock approach lane
fleet traffic manager occasionally deadlocks robots near the charging station
robots block each other at the dock entrance under high fleet utilization
